name: matters-blob-ds
//: Without this, deleting a blob leaves its document in the index forever. The row still
appears in search results and only fails when someone clicks it, because the download
URL is built from metadata_storage_path and the blob behind it is gone:
That is a live, user-visible defect - see infra/logicapps/tools/purge-index-orphans.ps1,
which cleans up the ones already stranded.
The policy was added directly on the live service and was missing here, so re-running
setup.ps1 would have silently removed it and made every future deletion permanent.
